elements.details:
| Chapter Title | Topic | Description of Algorithm | First Reference |
|---------------|-------|--------------------------|-----------------|
|               | Confidence interval for the mean | Using Python to calculate a confidence interval for the mean using the normal and t-distributions (two examples) | Statistical Inference and Confidence Intervals |

elements.summary: This table lists various Python algorithms related to statistical inference, hypothesis testing, correlation, regression, analysis of variance, and time series forecasting. Each row describes the topic, a brief description of the algorithm, and a reference to the relevant chapter or section in the textbook.
